scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,guess,contest,open -c blue,magenta,green,gray "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/server" "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/draw-guess" "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/draw-contest" "node scripts/dev-open.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fishing-work/draw-guess && npm run build -w @fishing-work/draw-contest && npm run build -w @fishing-work/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @fishing-work/draw-guess && npm run lint -w @fishing-work/draw-contest
